title: UneceFinancialAdjustment
description: A correction or modification to reflect actual financial conditions.

accountingDebitCreditStatusDirectionCode.description: The code specifying whether the financial adjustment must be subtracted or added.

actualAmount.description: An actual monetary value added or subtracted as a result of this financial adjustment.

actualDateTime.description: The actual date, time, date time, or other date time value of this financial adjustment.

actualQuantity.description: The actual quantity added or subtracted as a result of this financial adjustment.

claimRelatedParty.description: The claim related party for this financial adjustment.

financialAdjustmentReasonCode.description: A code specifying a reason for this financial adjustment.

invoiceReferenceDocument.description: The invoice document referenced for this financial adjustment.

reason.description: A reason, expressed as text, for this financial adjustment.

relatedTax.description: A trade tax related to this financial adjustment.
